pros: Securely manages and stores credentials across multiple devices and platforms.
Offers excellent value for money with a robust free tier and competitive pricing for teams.
Browser extensions and autofill features significantly streamline daily workflows.
cons: The user interface can feel functional but less polished compared to some competitors.
Autofill functionality occasionally behaves inconsistently or requires manual adjustment.
Setting up and managing organizational sharing, especially for new users, can be less intuitive.
changed: Con 3 was changed because the note '[friction] The personal vault Add menu has no Collection option; sharing requires first creating an organization from a 'New organization' link tucked into the vault filter sidebar.' and '[friction] After creating the organization the app jumps from Password Manager into a separate Admin Console with its own sidebar, so my saved CRM and note items were not visible where collections and members are managed.' provided a more specific and impactful example of a 'learning curve' related to a core team feature (sharing/organizations) rather than just 'advanced configurations' in general.
